label: Review Avatars
purpose: Display customer avatars with verified badges and review stat text for social proof
_notes:
Shows up to 5 customer avatar images with an optional verified checkmark badge each (avatar_N_verified), plus two independent two-line text groups (text_1_line_1/text_1_line_2 and text_2_line_1/text_2_line_2) — e.g. '2,847 reviews' / 'Trusted by pet parents'. All text fields are inline_richtext: do NOT wrap in

tags, use / for emphasis. Write BOTH text groups every time (each renders as its own pill and disappears entirely if left blank) — the base theme's design is two stacked social-proof pills, not one, so leaving text_2 empty makes the section look broken/incomplete compared to the theme's intended layout. Avatar images are left empty — the base theme's own design shows no avatar row at all, just the two text pills; if this block ever needs real avatars they must be genuine customer photos, never the product's own photos, which is exactly what leaving them empty (via _optional_image_settings) prevents. All remaining real settings (enable custom layout, alignment, corner radius, avatar size/offset/position, checkmark and star colors/sizes, an anchor-link scroll id, per-text background/border/padding/offset/mobile-size overrides, margins) are pure visual styling, omitted.
